info.title: Tazumo Marketplace API
info.description: Contract proposal. The read-only Discovery operations and the Identity, Admin role-grant, Privacy (erasure, export) and quote (synthetic fees, VAT rates to re-verify) operations have a reference implementation in apps/api (synthetic fixture data, not deployed). All prices are server-calculated. Checkout is disabled in the current clients.

slug.description: Stable human-readable identifier, unique among merchants (for example `piazza-local`)

synthetic.description: True when the record is synthetic demonstration data, not a real merchant or offer

slug.description: Stable human-readable identifier, unique among products (for example the fixture product ID `pizza`)

synthetic.description: True when the record is synthetic demonstration data, not a real merchant or offer

optionGroups.description: Present only when the product has options

paymentMethod.description: Only cash applies the market's cash rounding (whole crowns for CZK)

commerceMarket.description: Commerce rule set applied (ISO country code)

redeemable.description: false until quotes are persisted for order creation

lines.description: One entry per request item, in request order

Quote.description: Server-authoritative price breakdown. total is the exact total; payable and rounding differ from it only for cash payments. Fees are synthetic and VAT rates are research data to re-verify.

paymentMethodToken.description: Opaque provider token, never raw card details

details.description: Whitelisted event details (role, merchantId, initiator); never personal data of other people

SignedMoney.description: Money that may be negative, such as a rounding adjustment

OptionSelection.description: Option group ID to chosen option IDs. In a request, a group left out takes its available defaults and an empty array chooses none. In a quote line, every group of the product is listed.

labelKey.description: Translation key; clients resolve the label

priceDeltaMinor.description: Signed change to the unit price in minor units of the product price currency

available.description: Resolved when the response is built; an unavailable option cannot be selected

labelKey.description: Translation key; clients resolve the label

ProductOptionGroup.description: Validated and priced by @tazumo/product-options on every surface; the quote is authoritative

labelKey.description: Translation key; clients resolve the label

QuoteLine.description: Snapshot of the priced line: the resolved selection, each chosen option with its delta, and the resulting unit price
